rci1_using_msad.detail: Two independent datasets from different institutions (discovery and replication datasets).
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "In this study, 297 patients with depression and 256 healthy controls (HCs) from two independent Chinese dataset were included: a discovery dataset (105 never-treated first-episode patients and matched 130 HCs) and a replication dataset (106 patients and matched 126 HCs)."

rci2_using_epd.detail: Only in-house Chinese discovery and replication datasets are described; no established public datasets are named.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "The discovery dataset included 105 nevertreated first-episode patients with depression and matched 130 healthy controls (HCs) recruited from the first out-patient services of Department of Psychiatry, the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University... The replication dataset included 106 patients with depression and matched 126 HCs."

rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "The discovery dataset included 105 nevertreated first-episode patients with depression and matched 130 healthy controls (HCs) recruited from the first out-patient services of Department of Psychiatry, the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University... The replication dataset included 106 patients with depression and matched 126 HCs."

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HCs. Two separate Gaussian process regression normative models were trained on HCs from each dataset independently. All HCs in each dataset served as the training reference cohort (no train/test split mentioned for NM).
rci5_n.supporting_text: "The discovery dataset included 105 nevertreated first-episode patients with depression and matched 130 healthy controls (HCs)"; "The replication dataset included 106 patients with depression and matched 126 HCs."; "we trained a Gaussian process regression model to predict regional GMV from age and sex in HCs and then applied the trained model to infer regional GMV of patients"
rci5_n.location: Han2024A.pdf.md: Methods / Participants, L81; Methods / Determination of individualized gray matter atrophy pattern, L109

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase. Male percentages reported in Table 1; male_n and female_n estimated from reported male percentage and total N. Discovery: 45.38% male of N=130 → 59 males, 71 females. Replication: 47.17% male of N=126 → ~59 males (closest integer; 59/126=46.83%, slight discrepancy with reported 47.17%), 67 females.

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; age in years; mean and SD reported directly in Table 1; age range (min-max) not reported for HCs
